name: Saying Goodbye
overview: Saying goodbye in Scripture involves trusting God's guidance and blessing as one moves forward, as seen in Genesis 24:56 where a servant requests to be sent on his way after the Lord prospered his journey. The blessing of the Lord's protection and favor is central, reflected in Numbers 6:24's prayer for God's keeping. Psalms emphasize the joy and blessing that come from walking in God's ways (Psalms 1:1, 21:6) and the assurance that the steps of the righteous are ordered by the Lord (Psalms 37:23). Even in times of departure, lifting eyes to God as the source of help remains vital (Psalms 121:1).
